title: 扬升大师教义基金会（AMTF）详细介绍
brief: 介绍AMTF扬升大师教义基金会的成立背景、发展历程、宗旨使命与典籍出版工作
cn:
扬升大师教义基金会（AMTF）

1979 年，经由杰拉尔丁・因诺森特女士与盖伊・巴拉德先生传递的扬升大师口述开示不再向大众开放。为此，扬升大师教义基金会于 1980 年成立，目标是收集全部大师讲论，整理整编并重新刊印。这项工作通过以下步骤完成：

  • 维尔纳・施罗德辞去专业工程师的工作提前退休，全身心投入这项工作，保全 “自由之桥” 的整套教法。
  • 基金会走访了 “我是活动” 与 “自由之桥” 的创始成员，展开访谈；与参与创立自由之桥的罗杰・安科纳、杰拉尔丁的秘书爱丽丝・舒茨，以及圣哲曼指派的信使威廉・卡西尔（曾追随巴拉德先生修行）深度交流，收获大量关键资料。卡西尔先生曾在巴拉德夫妇家中居住。通过这些寻访，扬升存有当初为自由之桥定下的初心愿景得以重现，并纳入扬升大师教义基金会的宗旨与目标。
  • 收集经由杰拉尔丁传递的诸位扬升存有开示，共计约六千页。这项收集工作耗时数年。据估算，当时仅有四人持有完整原始文稿，且这些人不愿对外分享。曾有工作人员专程从雪士达山远赴瑞士图恩，只为誊抄其中一册典籍。
  • 收集经由巴拉德先生传递的诸位扬升存有开示，共计约七千页。
  • 对收集到的全部文稿开展考据梳理，将新编手稿按主题分类，整理为教学典籍重新出版。

这一步整理工作必不可少，因为 “自由之桥” 与 “我是活动” 的原始文稿并未按主题归类刊印。大众虽能接触到部分珍贵内容，但没有任何一个主题能在同一处查阅完整细节，大量章节标题也存在缺失。举一例说明：

时任小组负责人的维尔纳・施罗德想要讲解 “提顿灵修静修处的宗旨与作用” 这一主题时，发现需要翻阅《自由之桥期刊》，在多处零散内容里拼凑相关资料。

因此新版典籍确立核心整理原则：所有主题经完整考据后集中汇总、一次性完整呈现，无论个人自学还是社群共修，都能获得最完备的修习资料。

  • 2007 年，基金会完成全部一万三千页原始文稿的分类整编，同步推出英、德双语版本。如今英文版全套共26册，德文版24册，整套整理工作耗费数千工时。

如今学生们能够完整阅览经由巴拉德先生与杰拉尔丁传递的全部扬升存有开示。维尔纳・施罗德与所有共事人员均为无薪志愿者。

目前，德文版全套扬升大师教义基金会典籍可通过法国网站www.amtf-europe.org订购。

扬升大师教义基金会典籍内容概要

扬升存有教法的传播拓展

扬升大师伟大神圣指引者在《我是开示录》中阐释：“世间万事，没有比让这些典籍尽可能广泛传播更为重要的事。”

遵循这一指引，扬升大师教义基金会典籍被译为多国语言。如今面向大众推出德文24册、法文15册、葡萄牙文2册、中文4册。此外，巴拿马塞拉皮斯・贝伊修行小组也将多部典籍译为西班牙语。

维尔纳的妻子安妮特担任文稿编辑，协助丈夫完成全套典籍整编。安妮特此前拥有二十年从教经历，她与维尔纳搭档共事三十八年。

这类灵性智慧从未以如此条理清晰、时序完整的形式呈现于世。安妮特与维尔纳・施罗德在美国、墨西哥、巴拿马、巴西、乌拉圭、德国共开展一百零二场讲学；莉安・施罗德赴香港开设课程。

总而言之，依靠寥寥数位志愿者的不懈付出，保全并以教学典籍形式重新刊印自由之桥原始文稿的目标圆满达成。若无这份耕耘，二十世纪五十年代自由之桥恩典时期所有扬升存有传递的智慧开示，都将彻底湮没。

因此，凭借完成的各项成果，扬升大师教义基金会有充分资格成为 “自由之桥” 的正统传承者。事实胜于雄辩。

英文版扬升大师教义基金会典籍查阅网址：www.ascendedmaster.org

宗旨与使命

扬升大师教义基金会于 1980 年创立，唯一目标是接续初代 “自由之桥” 未竟的事业。创立前，团队已对这套教法开展多年考据，证实其内容真实可信，既适用于当下，也适配未来世代的修行环境。团队商定，依托以下行动方案，最大程度落实扬升大师的规划：

  • 收集总计约六千页原始口述开示文稿
  • 将开示原文整理成册重新出版，完整保留原文内容，向全人类免费开放阅览
  • 遵从扬升大师的意愿，将全套开示译为世界主流语种
  • 为有心修行者提供组建共修社群的渠道。社群除授课讲解宇宙法则如何落地日常生活外，另一核心作用是通过持诵祈文、圣火传递仪轨、冥想与圣歌，回馈大师们传递上万篇开示所耗费的神圣能量。所有共修社群均以扬升大师教义基金会整理出版的自由之桥典籍为共同修习根基。
  • 持续推出新作与定期通讯，统筹全球修习工作。（基金会现有英文版典籍32册、德文版25册、中文4册。）

凡愿意全心投入修行事业、加入埃尔・莫里亚灵性传道队伍的人，我们诚挚邀请你成为共事伙伴；这项事业得到圣哲曼与伟大白色兄弟会其余全体存有的全力支持。

扬升大师教义基金会发展历程

1930 年 8 月，扬升大师圣哲曼在雪士达山会见盖伊・W・巴拉德，向他阐释部分宇宙法则与人类演化历史。这段殊胜经历被记录于《揭秘奥秘》一书，标志着新纪元正式开启。依托授予圣哲曼的全新恩典许可，扬升大师首次得以向世人传授 “我是” 临在与紫罗兰转化火焰的相关智慧。

雪士达山会面之后，盖伊・巴拉德持续接收大师开示，并整理成书。无数听众在聆听他讲学的过程中获得疗愈。遗憾的是，1939 年巴拉德先生扬升离世后，这套典籍将近四十年不再向大众开放。

能量守恒法则同样适用于扬升大师。诸位神圣存有传递教法所倾注的海量能量，需要人类以修行回馈。倘若新晋修行者无法接触原始开示，这份能量又该如何返还？

正因如此，大师们必须另寻渠道延续教法传承。1952 年，伟大白色兄弟会获得全新恩典许可，委任杰拉尔丁・因诺森特为官方信使，她是扬升大师埃尔・莫里亚尚未扬升的双生火焰。一切只能从头起步，大师们完整复述了二十世纪三十年代传递过的全部核心内容，同时补充大量全新主题与珍贵细节。这批全新开示以 “自由之桥” 为名刊印。（详细内容参阅《自由之桥教法》；完整记述自由之桥从创立至解散全过程的典籍，为扬升大师教义基金会出版的《第一道光芒的启蒙考验》。）

遗憾的是，1961 年杰拉尔丁扬升之后，历史再度重演。大师的开示依旧无法广泛传播。1961 年之后，原始文稿仅有百分之五得以刊印。1979 年自由之桥夏季大会上，组织方宣布自由之桥已完成使命，并更改机构名称。

安妮特与维尔纳・施罗德作为自由之桥社群负责人出席了本次大会，二人认为这项决议违背了诸位扬升存有的本意。大师们早已说明，这座灵性之桥的使命，必须等全人类每一个灵魂都经由这座连通人界与神圣次元的桥梁、证得扬升，才算圆满。目睹此事，加之自由之桥管理层不愿完整刊印原始开示，二人于 1980 年创立非营利法人机构 —— 扬升大师教义基金会。

主要依靠这两位无薪全职志愿者的耕耘，保全并重印自由之桥原始典籍的目标顺利完成。二人从不以通灵管道自居，他们认为经由杰拉尔丁传递的扬升存有原始开示独一无二，是所有诚心求索伟大白色兄弟会智慧之人最优质的修习资料。他们希望让每一位专注修行者拥有选择：要么研读这份正统开示，要么参考当下各类通灵者传递的资讯。若无二人的付出，自由之桥原始教法终将彻底消亡。

历经十年搜集整理，全部原始文稿悉数找回；如今完整、原汁原味向大众免费开放，未掺入任何后世通灵内容。

值得一提的是，截至 2014 年 2 月，共有七十七名自称通灵管道的人联系基金会，希望获得基金会认可，成为官方信使，其中不少人在雪士达山当面接触。

这些前来寻求认证的通灵者，没有一人主动参与、出资、协助整理重印或传播杰拉尔丁传递的正统开示。倘若真是扬升大师认可的信使，怎会不愿投身这份保全教法的事业？事实胜于雄辩。

扬升大师教义基金会创立的唯一初衷：保全自由之桥时期诸位扬升存有的原始开示，使其免于失传，重新向全人类开放，并完成大师们为自由之桥定下的完整规划。

修行者若深入考据这套教法便会发现，自由之桥原始典籍自成完整体系，无需后世通灵者补充修订。依循典籍实修，人便能在此生证得扬升。这些指引超越时间限制，适用于过去、当下与未来所有世代的人类。大师将这套内容称作 “为后世世代撰写的新纪元圣经”。

我们诚挚邀请你参与扬升大师教义基金会全球各地的修习活动!
en:
THE ASCENDED MASTER TEACHING FOUNDATION (AMTF)

In 1979 the dictations of the Ascended Masters, as given through Miss Geraldine Innocente and Mr. Guy Ballard, were no longer available to the general public. Therefore, in 1980 the AMTF was founded with the goal to gather all of the discourses, compose them in own words and to re-publish them. This task was accomplished using the following steps:

Werner Schroeder took an early retirement from his job as a Professional Engineer to devote himself completely to that task and to save the teachings of the Bridge to Freedom.

Interviews with the founding members of the I AM Activity and the Bridge to Freedom. Discussions with Roger Ancona, who participated in establishing the Bridge to Freedom, Alice Schutz, Secretary to Geraldine Innocente and William Cassiere, a messenger appointed by Saint Germain, who had worked with Mr. Ballard, were very helpful. Mr. Cassiere, at one time, had lived in the home of Mr. and Mrs. Ballard. This way the original vision of the Ascended Beings for the Bridge to Freedom was re-discovered and included in the goals and purposes of the AMTF.

Collecting the messages of the Ascended Host, as given through Geraldine Innocente, of about 6000 pages. This process took several years to complete. It was estimated that only four persons had a complete set of the original texts and those individuals refused to share it. At one time a trip from Mt. Shasta to Thun, Switzerland was necessary to copy just ONE book.

Collecting the messages of the Ascended Host, as given through Mr. Ballard, of about 7000 pages.

To research the gathered texts, separating the new manuscripts into subjects and re-publishing these as textbooks.

This step was necessary because the original texts of the Bridge to Freedom and the I AM Activity was not published according to subjects. The general public was presented some very valuable information. However not a single subject was ever presented in all detail, at ONE location; many chapter titles were missing. Here is one example:

When Werner Schroeder, acting as Group Director, wanted to teach the subject Goals and function of the Teton Retreat he discovered he had to look up this subject in 11 monthly publications entitled Journal of the Bridge to Freedom and in 165 different places.

Therefore, the new edition would consist of the principle that the student, both in his individual study as well as in groups, is served best if every subject, after thorough research, is presented to him JUST ONCE, and in all detail.

In 2007 the goal was accomplished to arrange the original text of 13000 pages into different subjects and to publish the result in both English and German. There are now 26 volumes in English and 24 volumes in German. It took thousands of hours to achieve this result.

Therefore, students have now the advantage to be informed of ALL messages of the Ascended Host that came through Mr. Ballard and Geraldine Innocente. Werner Schroeder and all other co-workers functioned as unpaid volunteers.

At this time all AMTF books in German may be ordered in France from the webpage www.amtf-europe.org

DETAILS OF AMTF-BOOKS

EXPANSION OF THE TEACHING OF THE ASCENDED HOST

In the book I AM Discourses the Ascended Master named Great Divine Director explained: There is nothing in life more important than to give these books the greatest possible distribution.

Following this guideline AMTF-books were translated into different languages. The general public is now offered 24 AMTF-titles in German, 15 titles in French, 2 titles in Portuguese and 4 titles in Chinese. In addition, several books have been translated by Grupo Serapis Bey in Panama into Spanish.

Werners wife Annette supported his effort of compiling the AMTF-books by being the editor. Formerly she had worked 20 years as a teacher. Annette and Werner worked together as a team for 38 years.

Never before had this type of knowledge been presented in such a structured, chronological order. Annette and Werner Schroeder gave 102 lectures in the US, Mexico, Panama, Brazil, Uruguay and Germany. Liane Schroeder gave lectures in Hong Kong.

To summarize, the goal to save and re-publish the original texts of the Bridge to Freedom in the format of textbooks has been successfully accomplished through the efforts of a very small number of volunteers. Without this effort the knowledge of all of the messages given by the Ascended Host, as part of the Bridge to Freedom Dispensation of the 1950s would have been lost.

Therefore, based on its accomplishments, the AMTF can rightfully claim to be the successor of the Bridge to Freedom. Actions speak louder than words.

For AMTF-Books in English see www.ascendedmaster.org

Goals & Purpose

The Ascended Master Teaching Foundation (AMTF) was founded in 1980, with the exclusive goal of continuing the work of the original Bridge to Freedom. Prior to this, for many years, the foundation had researched these teachings and found them to be authentic and to be applicable to todays conditions as well as to those of the future. It was decided that the plan of the Ascended Masters could best be implemented by adopting the following plan of action:

  • Gathering the original dictations of some 6,000 pages
  • Re-publishing these dictations in book form, making no changes as to their content and making them freely available to all mankind
  • Translating the dictations into major foreign languages, according to the wishes of the Masters
  • Giving interested persons the opportunity to form study groups. Besides giving instructional lessons on how cosmic law applies to the students daily affairs, another purpose of these groups is to return the energy spent by the Masters in thousands of dictations through decreeing, performing the Transmission Flame Service and through contemplation and songs. These study groups have the common bond of the Bridge to Freedom material, published by the successor of this organization, the Ascended Master Teaching Foundation.
  • To coordinate the overall effort by publishing new publications and a newsletter. (Currently AMTF offers 32 books in English, 25 books in German and 4 books in Chinese.)

Individuals ready to put the shoulder to the wheel and join El Moryas Spiritual Caravan an effort fully supported by Saint Germain and the other members of the great White Brotherhood are cordially invited to become co-workers.

The History of The AMTF

In August 1930, the Ascended Master Saint Germain contacted Guy W. Ballard, on Mt. Shasta, and explained to him certain aspects of Cosmic Law and the history of mankind. This beautiful experience is recorded in the book Unveiled Mysteries and it heralded in the New Age. Under the new dispensation, given to Saint Germain, the Ascended Masters, for the first time, could give out information on the I AM Presence and the Violet Transmuting Flame.

After the experiences on Mt. Shasta, Guy W. Ballard received more messages which were incorporated into books. Many were healed while attending his lectures. Unfortunately, after the ascension of Mr. Ballard in 1939, these books, for about 40 years, were no longer made available to the general public.

The Law of Conservation of Energy applies also to the Ascended Masters. The tons of energy released by the Great Ones need to be returned by mankind. How can this energy be returned if new students do not have access to the original dictations?

It was primarily for this reason, that the Masters had to look elsewhere to carry forward their message. In 1952 the Great White Brotherhood received a new dispensation. They utilized Geraldine Innocente, the unascended twin-flame of the Ascended Master El Morya, as an authorized messenger. Forced to start totally anew, the Masters repeated, in substance, all of the data given previously in the 1930s. However, many subjects and many valuable details were added. These new dictations were published under the name The Bridge to Freedom. (For details, see The Teachings of the Bridge to Freedom.) For a complete history of the Bridge to Freedom Activity, from its inception to its dissolution, see the AMTF-book The Initiations of the First Ray.

Unfortunately, after the ascension of Geraldine Innocente in 1961, the earlier mistakes were repeated. Again, the messages of the Masters did not find the widest possible distribution. After 1961, only 5% of the original material was published. During the summer conference of the Bridge to Freedom in 1979, it was announced that the Bridge to Freedom had accomplished its goal, and that its name was changed.

Annette and Werner Schroeder, who, as group leaders of the Bridge to Freedom, attended this conference, did not feel that this decision was done in accordance with the wishes of the Ascended Host. The Masters had stated that the task of the Bridge would only be complete, after every member of the human race had passed over this spiritual bridge, connecting the human realm to the divine realm, and gained his ascension. This experience, and the unwillingness of the leaders of the Bridge to Freedom to publish almost all of the original dictations, led to the establishment of the AMTF, as a non-profit corporation, in 1980.

Mainly through the effort of these two individuals, who functioned as an unpaid staff, the goal of saving and re-publishing the original Bridge to Freedom publications has been successfully achieved. These volunteers never considered themselves as channels. They considered the original dictations, as given by the Ascended Host through Geraldine Innocente, as unique and the best material available for each sincere seeker after truth, wanting to study the teachings of the Great White Brotherhood. These volunteers wanted to give every dedicated student a choice between these dictations and the various messages of todays numerous channels. Without this effort, the original teachings of the Bridge to Freedom would have fallen into oblivion.

Over a period of 10 years, all of the original material was recovered and it is now freely available, in its entirety and original purity, without additional channelings.

It is noteworthy that, as of February 2014, 77 individuals who consider themselves channels, contacted the AMTF in an attempt to gain recognition as its new channel. Many of them we met in Mt. Shasta.

None of the channels, who contacted the AMTF to gain acceptance, had seized the opportunity to assist in the effort to preserve, fund, re-publish or distribute the original dictations given by the Ascended Host through Geraldine Innocente. Would a genuine messenger of the Ascended Host not have offered help? Actions speak louder than words.

The AMTF was founded for one purpose, alone namely, to save the original dictations of the Ascended Host as given during the Bridge to Freedom Activity, from oblivion, to again make them available to all mankind and to complete the plan of the Masters for the Bridge to Freedom.

If a student seriously investigates this teaching, he will find that the material of the original Bridge to Freedom stands on its own and needs no updating by one of todays channels. If practiced, it will enable the student to make the ascension in this embodiment. These instructions are timeless; they apply to mankinds situation of yesterday, today and tomorrow. The Masters called this material, the New Age Bible, written for generations yet to come.

You are cordially invited to participate in the worldwide activities of the AMTF.
